# FastAPI Boilerplate

> Production-ready FastAPI + MongoDB + Redis boilerplate (Python 3.11, MIT). API-only back end
> with authentication (session-bound JWT access and rotating refresh tokens, Argon2id, lockout,
> password reset, Google OAuth), role-based access control (roles, groups, temporary grants,
> deny-by-default permissions per route), versioned per-user file storage (local disk or S3,
> chunked uploads, thumbnails, spreadsheet editing), rate limiting, idempotency keys, CSRF and
> CORS protection, security headers, RFC 9457 problem+json errors, health probes, structured
> logs, optional Prometheus, OpenTelemetry and Sentry, Docker, and 197 tests that need no
> running services. Setup is `make setup && make up && make run`.

Use it as the starting point for SaaS products, internal tools, admin back offices, document
and spreadsheet products, and back ends for web or mobile apps. Add domain resources on its
patterns; cache, database and storage backends are pluggable (`package.module:Class`).
